summary: Added tokenizer-process Prometheus histograms for per-item multimodal download duration/bytes and full load duration, plus per-request load_mm_data and processor-call duration. Measurements use perf_counter intervals, preserve missing download observations for non-URL media, remain local to each thread/request, and are emitted on error paths. Regression coverage uses a bounded localhost PNG fixture and concurrent synthetic request stages.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression on the recorded base: the implementation rejected the metrics observer and had no request-stage timing hook. Raw output: reports/j-e925a005e32a/raw/failing-before.txt

37 tests and 15 subtests passed: real localhost HTTP download timing and byte size, in-memory absent-vs-zero semantics, decode error observation, concurrent request isolation, processor intervals, existing media error/decode behavior, and metrics collector DI. Raw output: reports/j-e925a005e32a/raw/regression-suite-final.txt

Actual Prometheus exposition for all five metric families; confirmed image download count/sum and bytes, audio load count, request load/processor sums, and absence of an audio download series. Raw output: reports/j-e925a005e32a/raw/prometheus-exposition.txt
Repository formatting, lint, spelling, AST, registry, and safety hooks. Raw output: reports/j-e925a005e32a/raw/pre-commit-second.txt

tests.what_was_measured: Prepared ROCm GPU execution on one AMD Instinct MI350X; a 2x2 FP32 matmul matched an independent NumPy reference with max absolute error 0.0. This validates the assigned GPU environment, not the CPU-side metrics behavior. Raw output: reports/j-e925a005e32a/raw/gpu-numerical-check.txt

gpu_execution.evidence: torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 reported one AMD Instinct MI350X and produced an exact NumPy-referenced FP32 matmul result; reports/j-e925a005e32a/raw/gpu-numerical-check.txt

remaining_limitations: No native or FlyDSL code changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.

A full model server was not started or model weights downloaded; Prometheus wiring was exercised directly through the real collector and media/processor implementation with bounded synthetic fixtures.

Specialized processor subclasses that completely replace BaseMultimodalProcessor.process_mm_data do not pass through the base HF processor-call timer; the common base path named in the issue is covered.
